notes: 6 test concepts, each built on one health & wellness inspiration ad from the 45-day Atria pull (research/data/inspiration_wellness_45d.csv) plus our winners/scripts.

concepts.angle: Blame-shift for women 60+: the pain isn't age, it's the shoe; three mechanisms; guarantee as the close
concepts.based_on: Inspiration: Osteva 'It's Not Weak Glutes. It's Menopause Musculoskeletal Syndrome.' (joint supplement, 11 days, top 0.2% impressions): blame-shift headline + 3 reasons + 'or it's FREE' guarantee. Ours: Survey: 47% of buyers are 65+, plantar fasciitis 25%, bunions 7%; Kyro 172 script 'running shoes don't provide enough support'
concepts.headline: It's not your age. It's your shoes.
concepts.prompt: Warm cream paper-textured background like a vintage health-magazine ad. Huge headline across the top in two lines: "It's not your age." in black Poppins ExtraBold, then "It's your shoes." in purple (#7A2FE0) Poppins ExtraBold. Left half: three stacked rows, each a short bold black line with a thin hand-drawn black arrow pointing right to the photo: "Flat soles = heel pain", "Narrow toes = bunion pain", "No grip = unsteady steps". Right half: a real phone photo of a woman in her 60s sitting on the edge of her bed in the morning light, tight crop from the knees down, feet on a wooden floor wearing the black-purple shoe from the reference photo, a pair, large and sharp (about 45% of the frame). Bottom strip, solid black bar full width with white Poppins ExtraBold text: "Feel the difference in 30 days, or your money back." and below it smaller white text "40% OFF · FREE SHIPPING". All typeset text is Poppins (Poppins ExtraBold headlines, Poppins SemiBold labels), never a script, serif or novelty font. Photographic parts must look like genuine phone photos, NOT AI: natural uneven light, real skin and fabric texture, slight grain, imperfect framing, no plastic HDR glow. All supporting text is large and bold (every line at least 1/25 of the canvas height, max 6 words per line), high contrast. Text colors are black, deep navy or white, plus at most one accent color for key words or solid fills. The shoe keeps its true natural proportions, never compressed, flattened or tiny. No logos, no icon badges, no buttons, no other text than quoted.

concepts.angle: Nurse heel pain as a 4-stage ladder of failed fixes ending in the shoe
concepts.based_on: Inspiration: Linda Baker '4 stages of leg swelling' / '4 Stages of Searing Shoulder Pain' (edema mineral, 33-38 days, top 0.1%): numbered ladder, each stage rejects a fix the reader already tried. Ours: Kyro 172 script ($70k): 'Running shoes don't provide enough support... painkillers aren't a long-term solution... you don't need $400 shoes'; 12-hour shift list winner ($858k)

concepts.prompt: Clean off-white background. Headline across the top in heavy black Poppins ExtraBold: "4 stages of nurse heel pain". concepts.angle: Make the invisible visible: thermal map of where 12-hour shifts hit the foot, guarantee as the headline
concepts.based_on: Inspiration: Hollow Socks 'Unclog your legs, or your money back' (compression socks, 21 days, top 0.1%): thermal heat-map + guarantee as the headline. Ours: Diagram winner 'Shoes for 12-hour shifts' ($457k, pain-area inset); B6 Emily RN script 'no more aching heels by hour eight'

concepts.headline: We tested the top 4 nurse shoes.
concepts.prompt: Real, slightly lo-fi phone photo of a hospital break-room table with a coffee cup and a lanyard badge, fluorescent light, blurred lockers behind. Four shoes lined up on the table, all without any logos: a generic grey-and-neon running shoe, a plain white rubber clog, a beige memory-foam slip-on, and on the right the black-turquoise shoe from the reference photo, the largest and closest to the camera (about 35% of the frame), sharp. Across the top of the photo, on the plain wall area, the only headline, large black Poppins ExtraBold in two lines: "We tested the top" "4 nurse shoes." A small yellow sticky note stuck to the wall above our shoe with thick black marker handwriting: "Only one lasted 12 hours". There is no other headline or slogan. Under each shoe a large white rounded label (text at least 1/25 of the canvas height) with bold black Poppins text: "Foam flat by noon", "Heavy, no arch", "Narrow toes", and under ours a solid black label with white text "Lasted 12 hours".
